authored_from: Articles (Serious)/technical/3B1B — Monitor - Formal Execution.md, §IX (The Monitor Engine) + the Additions (urgency is distance-to-V; the fit caveat that makes Kalman a declined import)
note: SPEC vectors for the per-sustain engine that OWNS the detection chain. The chain itself shipped in the detect slice; what was missing was the object that carries it between observations and hands an escalation to the OODA loop.

divergence.statement: The reference has no MonitorEngine: MonitorEngine, monitor_engine, kalman, detector, escalate, flatten_holarchy and belief are all grep-0 in apps/api/sustena/. But the sharpest statement of the gap is not a grep count — it is that the reference watches by RECOMPUTING and this engine watches by ACCUMULATING. GET /devui/state computes its widgets fresh on every poll, so nothing carries an EWMA level or a CUSUM accumulator between observations. A CUSUM is definitionally an accumulator; in a recompute-per-request design it does not merely lack an implementation, it has nowhere to live.

the_three_greppable_false_positives_name.ewma (1 hit) and cusum (1 hit): Both are the SAME comment, in curated_ui.py, and it is a comment recording their ABSENCE: the urgency proxy there notes that 'CUSUM/EWMA per §2 of the upgrade spec do not' exist yet. The only grep hits for the detectors are a note saying they are not there — worth naming precisely, because a reviewer skimming a hit count of 1 and 1 would draw the opposite conclusion.
the_three_greppable_false_positives_name.heartbeat (1 hit): devui.py's comment about the shell's event-count polling heartbeat — a UI refresh interval, not a monitor cadence.

term_by_term.per-sustain filters/detectors (§IX): RUST-AHEAD. grep-0, and structurally blocked: there is no object per sustain to hold them, because the monitoring surface is recomputed per request.
term_by_term.the ingest() pipeline: RUST-AHEAD, and built in the NATIVE form — see below. The reference has no pipeline at all; it computes a display value and discards it.
term_by_term.Kalman (MON-2): DECLINED IMPORT, not a gap, and this is the one term where 'rust-ahead' would be the wrong word entirely. §IX runs Kalman → EWMA → CUSUM; the article's own Additions say the Kalman apparatus assumes a continuous linear ODE that discrete event-sourced state is not, and that the Sustena-native form is distance-to-V on the fold with CUSUM/EWMA over that series. So this engine runs W = d(s,V) → EWMA → CUSUM. Building a Kalman stage would add an estimator for noise this state model does not have, in front of a detector that does not need it.
term_by_term.Controller.escalate on WARNING+: RUST-AHEAD, and it is what makes OBSERVE self-driving. Before this slice the chain existed and nothing drove it; now an escalating ingest hands an OodaObservation to the loop.
term_by_term.BeliefStateTracker (MON-8): RUST-AHEAD and NOT BUILT HERE. A separate ⬜ row, left as a clean seam with no placeholder field — an empty belief_trackers map would read as built-and-idle rather than absent.
term_by_term.WidgetVisualEncoder / render_widget (MON: RUST-AHEAD and NOT BUILT HERE. Same treatment: a separate ⬜ row, no stub.
term_by_term.tick() at display refresh rate: DELIBERATELY OUTSIDE CORE. No clock, no scheduler — the same boundary CTL-9 draws for the Controller's WHILE system.running. The host calls drive(); this module is the body of one pass, not the loop around it.

divergence.what_python_does_have_and_why_it_is_not_: The Monitor panel is real, shipped and in daily use: GET /devui/state returns live state, events, operative statuses, constraint evaluations and three computed widgets, and the panel polls it. Slice 10's evaluate_operatives() is a real triggered pass that produces suggestions. Both genuinely watch. What neither can do is REMEMBER: every value is derived from the current state on the current request, so 'this has been drifting for six readings' is not expressible — not because the code for a detector is missing, but because there is no per-sustain object with a lifetime longer than one HTTP request for a detector's state to sit in. That is precisely MON-9, and it is why the backlog recorded it as 'scheduling external, no heartbeats' (#24).
divergence.when_python_catches_up: These cases become parity vectors unchanged; nothing in them is Rust-specific.
divergence.not_a_divergence_in: R1 behaviour. The engine is additive, owns only its own detectors, and calls region/detect/pincer unmodified.

fixture.why: A minimum operating float of 1000, so a state below it is genuinely outside V and W is the shortfall. The `pending` dimension is deliberately NOT bounded by the region — it is what proves the two escalation inputs are not redundant: a distance cannot measure what V does not describe.

engine_cases.name: an_engine_with_no_sustains_is_refused
engine_cases.why: An engine watching nothing would report calm forever, which is the most dangerous possible output of a monitor — indistinguishable from an engine watching everything and finding nothing.

engine_cases.name: flatten_holarchy_orders_parents_before_children
engine_cases.why: §IX's flatten_holarchy. There is no holarchy TYPE in core to walk, so this takes the flattened declaration and validates the links rather than pretending to traverse a tree it was not given. Ordering is deterministic so a replay is reproducible.

engine_cases.name: a_cycle_in_the_declared_holarchy_is_refused
engine_cases.why: A holon that contains itself is not a hierarchy. Caught at construction, where it is cheap, rather than at traversal, where it is a hang.

engine_cases.name: a_parent_that_was_never_declared_is_refused
engine_cases.why: A dangling parent link would silently place a child at the root, which is a different holarchy from the one someone declared.

engine_cases.name: a_duplicate_sustain_is_refused
engine_cases.why: Two declarations for one id means two chains for one household, and which one accumulated what would depend on insertion order.

engine_cases.name: each_sustain_keeps_its_own_chain
engine_cases.why: ★ THE POINT of per-sustain ownership. One household's drift must not move another's accumulator — which is exactly what a single shared detector, or a recomputed-per-request value, cannot promise.

engine_cases.name: an_unwatched_sustain_is_refused
engine_cases.why: Ingesting into a sustain nobody declared would create a chain with no declared parameters — α, μ₀, δ and h invented rather than read.

pipeline_cases.name: ingest_computes_w_as_distance_to_v_not_the_raw_state
pipeline_cases.why: ★ The Additions' 'urgency is distance-to-V'. What enters the detector is the shortfall against the household's own declared region, not the balance — so a large number inside V is calm and a small shortfall outside it is not.

pipeline_cases.name: the_ewma_smooths_across_ingests_because_the_engine_owns_it
pipeline_cases.why: ★★ THE THING THAT WAS MISSING. The chain has STATE, and until this slice nothing carried it between observations. With α = 0.5 the second reading lands halfway toward the new level — which is only possible because the first one was remembered.

pipeline_cases.name: a_quiet_stream_does_not_escalate
pipeline_cases.why: Watching is metered; looking spends a budget. Ten quiet ingests produce ten real readings and zero observations — and observation() is None, so there is no route from a quiet ingest into OBSERVE at all.

pipeline_cases.name: a_sustained_drift_eventually_escalates
pipeline_cases.why: The CUSUM doing what an accumulator is for: a shift held long enough crosses h. This is the one behaviour a recompute-per-request design structurally cannot produce.

pipeline_cases.name: there_is_no_kalman_stage
pipeline_cases.why: ★ THE DECLINED IMPORT, checked rather than asserted. §IX runs Kalman → EWMA → CUSUM. What reaches the EWMA here is W itself — the first observation seeds the smoother directly from d(s,V), with nothing having estimated it first.

self_driving_cases.name: a_quiet_ingest_leaves_the_loop_untouched
self_driving_cases.why: The common case. The chain advanced, nobody was disturbed, and nothing was held back — because nothing tried to go.

self_driving_cases.name: an_escalating_ingest_drives_the_loop_into_orient
self_driving_cases.why: ★★ THE PROOF OF VALUE. A stream of state updates through ONE engine advances the chain until the CUSUM crosses, and that crossing walks the OODA loop out of OBSERVE — with nobody calling observe() by hand. This is what 'OBSERVE is self-driving' means, and it is the whole of MON-9's escalation clause.

self_driving_cases.name: a_signal_alone_drives_the_loop_even_without_a_cusum_crossing
self_driving_cases.why: ★ Why escalation has TWO inputs rather than one. The state is comfortably inside V, so W = 0 and the CUSUM never stirs — and a declared trajectory signal watching `pending`, a dimension the region does not bound at all, fires anyway. A distance cannot measure what V does not describe.

self_driving_cases.name: watching_continues_while_the_loop_is_busy_and_says_who_held_it
self_driving_cases.why: ★ §III: 'Monitor is always running at OBSERVE. Controller only surfaces when the OODA loop has reached DECIDE.' A reading arriving mid-cycle is RECORDED — the history grows, the accumulator advances — and is NOT forced into a busy loop. held_back names the phase that declined it, so a deferred hand-off is visible rather than looking like the reading was ignored.

self_driving_cases.name: a_persistent_signal_does_not_repeatedly_drive_observe
self_driving_cases.why: The pincer's refractory debounce doing its job one layer up. A condition that stays true does not re-drive OBSERVE on every ingest — the difference between a monitor and an alarm that will not stop. And the suppression stays VISIBLE all the way up here, in the report's debounced list.

disclosed_limits.name: the_history_is_not_truncated
disclosed_limits.why: Trajectory signals are σ_k: S^t → {0,1}, so the engine retains each sustain's observed states, and it grows without bound. It does NOT truncate, because dropping the oldest silently changes what a bounded Never can conclude — precisely the class of quiet wrongness the three-valued verdict exists to prevent. history_len() exposes the growth so a host can see it and decide, rather than having the decision made invisibly here.
